validity.recommendation: P2327 (Kovykta-Sayansk-Irkutsk, proposed, 660km, 2.50 bcm/y) is a real, government-documented project -- named as 1 of 6 objects in a 2015 PM Medvedev-signed federal decree for China-export-framework gas transport infrastructure (versia.ru, vsp.ru, both independently corroborating) and referenced in a 2021-2025 Gazprom/Irkutsk Oblast gasification program (interfax_wb, 20.6bn RUB). NOT a duplicate of P5510 (Kovykta-Zhigalovo): official sourcing (interfax_wb, novayagazeta.ru, tass2_wb) describes 'Kovykta - Zhigalovo - Sayansk - Irkutsk' as ONE broader historical corridor vision, with Kovykta-Zhigalovo (P5510) and Kovykta-Sayansk-Irkutsk (P2327) as distinguishable legs/segments of it, not the same line under two names. Both GEM rows currently carry a blank SegmentName -- recommend populating SegmentName on both (e.g. 'Sayansk-Irkutsk leg' / 'Zhigalovo leg') so the relationship is explicit rather than inferable only from route text, which risks a future researcher merging or deleting one as a false duplicate.
validity.researcher_notes: Documents read to exhaustion this pass for the family: interfax_wb.html (2021-2025 program, 20.6bn RUB, explicit Kovykta field location in Zhigalovsky district, names the full corridor 'Kovykta-Zhigalovo-Sayansk-Irkutsk'), tass2_wb.html (13-Mar-2023, Kovykta-Zhigalovo length >110km, target 2024-2025), versia_full.txt + vsp_full.txt (2015, both independently confirm the federal decree grouping this project with Power of Siberia), novayagazeta.ru (2024, corroborates the corridor framing). No source found that treats P2327 and P5510 as literally the same pipeline under duplicate entries; the shared 'Kovykta' origin and absence of SegmentName is what creates the duplicate-suspect appearance, not the underlying facts. Second-source debt remains open on P2327's Capacity/Length (existing energybase.ru ref confirmed access-blocked, no Wayback fallback, no independently fetchable replacement found within lean-pass budget) and P2327's Diameter/Start (no source found at all) -- recorded honestly as UNRESOLVED in the paired fills[] records, not silently dropped.
